title: HireQuotient’s EasySource Elevated to Featured Listing on Paylocity Marketplace
content_md: San Francisco, United States, October 2nd, 2026/TechnologyWire/-- HireQuotient , an enterprise-grade AI-native recruiting platform, announced today that its flagship AI sourcing agent, EasySource, has been officially featured on the Paylocity (NASDAQ: PCTY) Marketplace just under a month after going live. It is noteworthy that HireQuotient’s EasySource is amongst the 8 AI softwares featured on Paylocity , and most other featured ones are background check softwares. This rapid marketplace recognition highlights the surging demand for autonomous talent sourcing tools that natively integrate with core HR systems. The Paylocity integration delivers EasySource’s powerful capabilities directly to Paylocity’s extensive customer base. Rather than solving for internal competence evaluation, EasySource is engineered to directly tackle the primary drivers of mid-market hiring challenges: severe pipeline constraints, speed imperatives, and reducing manual sourcing efforts in the frontline space. By deploying an AI sourcing agent that discovers, evaluates, and engages candidates autonomously, mid-market organizations can instantly scale their reach without expanding their recruiting headcount. This powerful synergy is already driving compounding value for shared customers across highly complex industries.
